problem.title: Modern work creates noise.
problem.body: Busy modern professionals do not need more input. They need time to process and review what is already in their mind. Clear decision making starts when thoughts, emotions, facts, and assumptions are separated.
points: Information, tasks, emotions, facts, and assumptions get tangled together.
Unprocessed thoughts keep reopening and make it harder to see what matters.
Without review, pressure turns into overthinking, hesitation, and unclear decisions.

method.title: Red Pen Thought Review™
method.body: A decision-making and reflection framework for overloaded professionals. It helps people externalize thinking, review it with distance, clarify what matters, and move from reflection into action.

steps.title: Write
steps.text: Put what is occupying mental space onto paper before trying to solve it.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Use the red pen to look again with distance and separate fact, interpretation, and emotional noise.

steps.title: Clarify
steps.text: Identify the real question, hidden decision, or priority underneath the noise.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: Choose the next clear action, conversation, boundary, or decision.

redPen.title: Why use a red pen
redPen.body: The red pen creates psychological distance between you and your thoughts. Changing pen colour switches you from expression to observation — so you can mark what matters and revise your next move with less emotional noise.

aiEra.title: AI gives you answers. Only you can review your own thinking.
aiEra.body: AI can generate answers instantly. But it cannot tell you what you actually think, avoid, feel, repeat or believe. Red Pen Review is designed to help you process your own thinking before relying on external judgement. The tangible experience of writing stimulates the senses, reaching deeper into your cognition than a screen ever can.
